dashboard.title: Dashboard and usage
dashboard.description: Choose dashboard pages, their dock and rotation order, and the HA entities they show. Select climate, light, and switch entities to group automatically by Home Assistant Area (up to four Areas and five controls per Area); unassigned entities appear together. Home and Display Settings stay available. Add up to three extra AI providers and up to five named sensors; Claude is built in. Reset timestamps on quota entities are detected automatically where available; optional reset-time entities can override them. Hidden pages leave navigation and rotation. Six page-order slots control both dock order and auto-rotation; Camera remains a header shortcut.

alerts.title: Alert rules
alerts.description: Add threshold rules using the sensor's own units. Warning thresholds optionally color sensor rows as they approach the limit. Comparisons are strict; hysteresis controls when a breached rule clears. On-device acknowledgement hides the incident until recovery; a 15-minute snooze resurfaces it if it remains active. Optionally route alerts to a related page; after clearing, it stays visible for 10 seconds unless touched, then the previous page returns.

error.invalid_dashboard: Check selected entities and page visibility. Room controls support climate, light, and switch entities in up to four Home Assistant Areas, with at most five devices per Area. Configure no more than three additional AI providers; provider names must be unique and at most 8 characters, and each provider needs a session or weekly quota sensor. Configure no more than five named sensor rows with names up to 18 characters. The six rotation order slots must each contain a different page. Page and camera refresh intervals must be 10–120 seconds in 5-second steps.

init.title: Reconfigure the CYD ESPHome device
init.description: This integration needs the device-prefixed display_alert, clear_alert, and dismiss_alert services. Check that this entry selects the correct ESPHome device, install firmware exposing all three actions, then continue to verify the registered services.
